episode_summary: In this episode, Julia Linquist discusses the challenges of balancing a successful real estate career with family life. Michael Opyd provides actionable insights on delegating tasks, focusing on high-value transactions, and adopting a mindset of consistency to reduce stress and improve clarity. Listeners will learn how to implement systems to manage workload and achieve a better work-life balance.
